verdict.rationale: dltHub documents run observability: the CLI and the Web UI at app.dlthub.com monitor pipeline health, inspect logs and diagnose failures. Runs can be observed after deploy, every run is logged and auditable, and an MCP server can inspect runs. Nothing in the evidence shows per-sync row counts or failure alerts to Slack, email or webhooks, which are core parts of the story. Missing for 10: per-sync row-count reporting, Slack/email/webhook failure alerting, independent hands-on corroboration of monitoring.
